title: PowerPro Spectra Braid
seoTitle: PowerPro Braid Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Choose a PowerPro Spectra strength and reel to estimate capacity, calculate mono backing, compare diameters, and plan the right retail spool size.
excerpt: The original four-carrier PowerPro, made with Spectra fiber. A thin, low-stretch main line for freshwater and saltwater setups, with a wide choice of strengths. This guide covers original PowerPro, not Super8Slick V2 or Maxcuatro.

title: Seaguar InvizX Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar InvizX Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Choose an InvizX strength and reel to estimate full-spool capacity, check whether 200 yards is enough, plan backing, and compare exact diameters.
excerpt: A 100% fluorocarbon main line for freshwater fishing, offered from 4 to 25 lb. Seaguar positions InvizX around soft handling and low memory. Plan a full fluorocarbon fill or a shorter working section over mono backing; a short leader on braid is a different setup.

title: Berkley Trilene XL Monofilament
seoTitle: Trilene XL Diameter Chart & Reel Capacity Guide | ReelCalc
seoDescription: Check Berkley Trilene XL diameters from 2 to 30 lb, estimate how much fits your reel, compare other mono lines, and plan a full fill or optional backing.
excerpt: Berkley's smooth-casting nylon monofilament, available in a wide range of strengths. This guide covers Trilene XL, not Trilene XT, Big Game, or Trilene fluorocarbon. The chart uses the current U.S. filler and bulk lineup, with package length matched to each strength.

title: Seaguar Tatsu Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar Tatsu Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Tatsu diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Tatsu is Seaguar's double-structure fluorocarbon main line. Two fluorocarbon resins are combined in one line, with Seaguar emphasizing suppleness and strength. This guide covers the listed 4-25 lb sizes and helps you budget a full fill or a working section over backing.

title: Seaguar AbrazX Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar AbrazX Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar AbrazX diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: AbrazX is Seaguar's abrasion-focused fluorocarbon main line. The manufacturer positions it for fishing around cover such as rocks, docks, and timber. Its 4-25 lb range includes very different diameters, so select a strength before checking reel capacity or buying a spool.

title: Seaguar Red Label Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar Red Label Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Red Label diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Red Label is Seaguar's value-oriented fluorocarbon main line, with manufacturer positioning aimed at baitcasting reels. The current range runs from 4 to 20 lb. Package length changes at the heavy end, so a Red Label spool is not automatically a 200-yard spool.

title: Seaguar Smackdown Braid
seoTitle: Seaguar Smackdown Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar Smackdown diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: Smackdown is an eight-strand braid. This guide uses Seaguar's current Stealth Gray diameter chart and assigned 150- and 300-yard variants. Select an exact strength to compare spool capacity and plan a braid working length over mono backing.

title: Seaguar BRAWLR Monofilament
seoTitle: Seaguar BRAWLR Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar BRAWLR diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: BRAWLR is Seaguar's announced monofilament line, listed from 2 to 30 lb. Seaguar describes a temperature-controlled manufacturing process called PTD. This is a specification-based planning guide; a listing or capacity estimate does not establish retail availability or independent performance results.

title: Seaguar JDM R18 Fluorocarbon
seoTitle: Seaguar JDM R18 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar JDM R18 diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: JDM R18 Mainline is Seaguar's Japan-market fluorocarbon offered through its JDM collection. It uses two fluorocarbon resins and comes on 100-meter spools, labeled approximately 109 yards. The range includes intermediate strengths such as 5, 7, and 14 lb.

title: Seaguar JDM PEX8 Braid
seoTitle: Seaguar JDM PEX8 Diameter & Reel Capacity | ReelCalc
seoDescription: See Seaguar JDM PEX8 diameters by strength. Check full-spool capacity for your reel, plan backing, and compare exact line diameters.
excerpt: JDM PEX8 is Seaguar's eight-strand metered braid for finesse-oriented applications. It pairs a pink main color with contrasting green markings and is offered on 200-meter spools, labeled approximately 219 yards. Its six strengths run from 12 to 33 lb.
